items.description: Gently tap your lap, a surface, or point to this cue.

items.label: Clap
items.description: Bring hands together comfortably, or point to this cue.

items.label: Pause
items.description: Rest for one beat; observing is welcome.

configuration.retry_feedback: Try another approach. You can ask for support.

lesson_metadata.official_competency: Perform basic dance steps /movements

distracted.cue: Look at the current item and choose the next small step.

relaxed.cue: Take your time. Choose when you are ready.

overstimulated.cue: We will do one small step at a time.
